summary: The delivery page answers what delivery costs and how long it takes. The facts are clear and in a table, but the page doesn't link to returns or say when free delivery applies at checkout, and the table is unreadable on a phone. Most important: the costs as a short, phone-friendly list.
audience: Customers about to order, checking cost and time.
tasks: Check whether they deliver to their area

purpose.clear.evidence: Heading „Delivery Information“ and the first sentence.

purpose.tasks.evidence: The table gives price and time per option.

content.complete.evidence: No link to returns, no cut-off time for standard delivery, „Islands … please call“ without a number.

content.current.evidence: Nothing dated on the page itself.

action.primary.evidence: No next step: no link back to shopping or to returns.

nav.menu.evidence: Seven green tabs (Home … Sale!) plus a second department list in the sidebar; the current tab is marked yellow, but Delivery, Returns and Contact live only in the footer.

visual.brand.evidence: The green house-and-leaf logo with the italic Millbrook wordmark, dark green #2f5420 / #4c7f2f and cream surfaces: recognisable on every page and fitting for a home and garden shop. Verdana 11 px is just old, not brand.

visual.hierarchy.evidence: The table is the first thing in the content.

visual.consistency.evidence: Same frame, nav, sidebar boxes and footer as the other pages.

trust.signals.evidence: The footer names the shop and its street address; there are no reviews, no returns promise near the products and the payment logos are plain text boxes.

inventory.why: Cards or a list that fit phones.

keep: The four delivery options with prices and times
design_input: Delivery options as a list of cards: name, time, price
